name: TribesPad
game: Tribes 2 (free official release) with the TribesNEXT client, Starsiege: Tribes 1.41 and Tribes: Vengeance (the free Revengeance release)

inputs.description: Nothing to select. The build downloads the free official Tribes 2 installer, the TribesNEXT client, the PlayT1 Starsiege: Tribes installer and the Revengeance release of Tribes: Vengeance, and checks each by SHA-256; all three games are in your app (on iPhone and iPad, Tribes: Vengeance's game files download inside the app when you pick it).

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode from the Mac App Store, open it once, and add the iOS platform.
